content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Research Scientist B Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post being advertised by AIIMS Bhopal?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bhopal is recruiting for the post of Research Scientist B (Non-Medical) on a contractual basis. This is a direct walk-in interview opportunity.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Scientist B (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Scientist B (Non-Medical) position. Candidates are encouraged to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG Degrees. For Engineering, IT, and CS fields, a Four Years Graduate Degree is acceptable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Scientist B (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Central Government rules for certain categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Scientist B (Non-Medical) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 56,000 per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Research Scientist B (Non-Medical) post is scheduled to be held on 18th September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Walk-in Interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. The exact venue details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).
